properties.title: B / Open triangular frame
properties.reason: Separate upper and lower chords; remove broad low-load panels.
properties.section: 24 mm-wide open web; dense chords; no mandatory internal plates

properties.title: C / Curved twin braces
properties.reason: Continuous curved seat-to-root paths with a large central opening.
properties.section: Open curved members across Z; compare solid and hollow member cores

properties.title: E / Deep keel and seat struts
properties.reason: Spend depth on chord separation, then cut the material between chords.
properties.section: Deeper open cradle; depth shown is an exploration parameter, not an approved limit

properties.title: D / Two direct seat arms
properties.reason: Give each seat a direct wall-root path; separate the inner and outer branches.
properties.section: Forked arms; through-width face coupling remains a 3D design variable

properties.title: F / Broad seat portals
properties.reason: Back each seat with a broad shoulder and rounded window, avoiding a thin neck.
properties.section: Thick root transitions; varied windows and independent seat backing

properties.title: A / Reshaped shear panels
properties.reason: Broader outer plates follow a new lower contour; generous windows remove area.
properties.section: Outer skins with variable internal plates or local cross-width diaphragms
